plain_prompt: This is a {modality} image. Describe the visible appearance and spatial distribution of {target} in at most 35 English words. Start directly with target appearance, not a generic introduction. Use only visible image evidence; do not infer a diagnosis or exact counts. If the target is uncertain, explicitly say so.
structured_prompt: This is a {modality} image. Identify up to three spatially distinct visible regions containing {target}. Return ONLY a JSON object in this exact schema: {{"regions":[{{"id":1,"description":"short visible evidence","box":[x1,y1,x2,y2]}}]}}. Use integer xyxy box coordinates normalized from 0 to 1000 relative to the full image: (0,0) top-left, (1000,1000) bottom-right. Each box must tightly contain its described target region; descriptions must be short English phrases. Do not infer hidden findings or a diagnosis. If no target is identifiable return {{"regions":[]}}. Do not include markdown or explanations.
